metadata.description: My curated collection of favorite agent skills.

plugins.name: hairline
plugins.description: Isometric line figures that answer the pointer, as self-contained HTML (hairline-create, hairline-adopt).

plugins.name: archify
plugins.description: Validated architecture, workflow, sequence, ERD and more as explorable standalone HTML, plus PR walkthrough diagrams (archify, archify-pr).

plugins.name: diagram-design
plugins.description: Editorial diagrams in your brand as self-contained HTML/SVG; imports draw.io, Mermaid, Excalidraw, PlantUML.

plugins.name: modern-web-guidance
plugins.description: Modern web platform best practices for HTML, CSS and client-side JS, plus building and publishing Chrome extensions.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Work with Obsidian vaults: Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, the Obsidian CLI and Headless, Defuddle and Knap.

plugins.name: hallmark
plugins.description: Design skill for new websites and pages that look designed, not generated; also redesigns and audits.

plugins.name: xlsx-artifacts
plugins.description: Anthropic's xlsx spreadsheet skill and web-artifacts-builder for multi-component React artifacts.

plugins.name: instagram-agent
plugins.description: Thirteen skills that run an Instagram account: reels, captions, carousels, stories, DMs, plans, audits and a humanizer.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Design fluency for frontend work: one skill with 24 commands to shape, audit, critique, polish and animate UI.
